environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a VPC with a standard S3 gateway endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3). The VPC endpoint has a FULL ACCESS policy (Effect: Allow, Principal: *, Action: s3:*, Resource: *). The task IAM role has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:HeadObject on arn:aws:s3:::shared-data-lake-prod/*. Multiple Fargate tasks run concurrently behind an ALB with no request deduplication. No S3 Object Lock or conditional writes configured on the bucket.
